description: B2B Dashboard + B2B Analytics + Source Analytics + Employee/Revenue analytics. Builds the dedicated B2B dashboard (KPI cards, funnel, activity section, employee leaderboard, partner health, source performance) and the Analytics screens, reusing the existing dashboard widgets/KPI tiles, recharts chart components, and the report-metrics/report-period analytics maths pattern. Depends on all prior data phases.
steps: Replace the FEAT-001 stub at src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/index.tsx with the real B2B Dashboard (spec section 3). Top KPI cards (reuse src/components/dashboard/widgets/kpi-tile.tsx and count-up): Total Prospects, Contacted, Interested, Active Partners, Follow-ups Due, Meetings This Week, Referrals This Month, B2B Bookings This Month, B2B Revenue This Month. Show period-over-period change where the existing KPI tile supports it.

B2B Funnel: a visual funnel over New Prospect -> Data Verified -> First Contact -> Contacted -> Interested -> Meeting/Discussion -> Partnership Discussion -> Partner Onboarded -> First Referral -> Active Partner, showing count and conversion percentage per stage. Put the funnel count/conversion computation in a pure tested helper in src/lib/b2b-analytics.ts (b2b-analytics.test.ts).

Activity section (Calls Made, WhatsApp/Communication, Emails, Meetings, Follow-ups Completed, Overdue Follow-ups), Employee leaderboard (Employee, Prospects Assigned, Prospects Contacted, Calls, Follow-ups, Meetings, Partners Onboarded, Referrals, Bookings, Revenue — sortable/filterable), Partner health distribution (Active & Referring, Active but No Recent Referral, Potential, Dormant, Lost), and Source performance table (Source, Prospects, Contacted, Interested, Meetings, Partners, Referrals, Bookings, Revenue). Reuse the leaderboard/table styling from admin/sales-performance.tsx.

Analytics routes under src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/analytics/: performance.tsx 'B2B Performance', source.tsx 'Source Analytics', employee.tsx 'Employee Performance', revenue.tsx 'Revenue Analytics'. Filters (spec section 14): Date Range, Month, Employee, City, State, Source, Firm Type, Partner Status, Lead Status — follow report-period.ts for the period controls. Charts/reports (reuse recharts via src/components/ui/chart.tsx and the recharts usage in sales-performance.tsx): Prospects Added by Month, Contact Rate, Response Rate, Meetings, Partnerships, Referrals, Bookings, Revenue, Revenue per Partner, Employee Performance, Source Performance. Source Analytics must read the configurable b2b_sources table (not a hardcoded list) and report the per-source funnel through to Bookings/Revenue.

All analytics aggregation maths that is pure goes into src/lib/b2b-analytics.ts with unit tests (funnel conversion, contact/response rate, per-source rollups, leaderboard aggregation, revenue-per-partner). Keep heavy chart components out of route-file exports (lazy-load from src/components/b2b/* if large) per the entry-chunk performance rule.

Add Dashboard + the Analytics subgroup to the B2B sidebar. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']) (b2b users see their own-scoped data via RLS; admin sees all). Rebuild/commit routeTree.gen.ts. Prettier new files.
acceptance_criteria: B2B Dashboard shows all 9 KPI cards, the 10-stage funnel with counts + conversion %, the activity section, a sortable/filterable employee leaderboard, partner-health distribution, and source performance.

Analytics screens (B2B Performance, Source Analytics, Employee Performance, Revenue Analytics) render the listed charts/reports with the full filter set; Source Analytics uses the configurable b2b_sources table.
All funnel/rate/rollup maths lives in tested src/lib/b2b-analytics.ts and tests pass.
Reuses existing KPI tile, chart, and leaderboard components; no heavy component exported from a route file.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
verification: Confirm b2b-analytics.test.ts covers funnel conversion and per-source rollups and would fail if the maths were reverted.
findings: Implemented. Pure maths in src/lib/b2b-analytics.ts (+ b2b-analytics.test.ts, 22 tests): buildFunnel (10-stage count + conversionFromTop/conversionFromPrev), contactRate/responseRate, activityBreakdown, sourceRollups (takes a configurable sources list, buckets unknowns), employeeLeaderboard, revenuePerPartner, partnerHealthDistribution, monthlyTrend, bookingValue (amount_after_tds||total_amount). Tests assert funnel conversion % and per-source rollup values, so reverting the maths fails them. Data fetched once via b2bAnalyticsQuery in src/lib/b2b-analytics-queries.ts (b2bDb(); RLS is the boundary — no manual scoping). Dashboard body in src/components/b2b/dashboard.tsx reuses KpiTile + CountUp (9 KPIs, incl. a custom RevenueTile for the ₹ value since KpiTile only animates numbers — mirrors sales-performance.tsx's local MetricCard rationale), a CSS funnel (no recharts), activity grid, partner-health list, sortable/filterable employee leaderboard, source table. Analytics screens under src/components/b2b/analytics/* (performance/source/employee/revenue) + shared FilterBar/charts in analytics-shared.tsx; useB2BAnalytics hook applies the 9-filter set and reads the CONFIGURABLE b2b_sources via listSources (seed constants only as empty-table fallback). Thin route files render the bodies. VERIFIED entry-chunk rule: recharts is isolated in chart-*.js; the client entry (clientEntry index-*.js) has 0 recharts refs; the /b2b dashboard route chunk imports no recharts; only the four analytics route chunks (+ _authenticated/sales-performance) pull chart-*.js. Nav: appended 4 flat items to NAV in app-shell.tsx (surgical, gated ['admin','b2b']). Gate: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 218 passed/16 files (196 prior + 22 new); bun run build ok; routeTree.gen.ts regenerated + committed. ESLint on new files: 0 errors (a few react-refresh/exhaustive-deps WARNINGS remain in analytics-shared.tsx by design — helper exports beside components, same pattern as sales-performance.tsx). Note: KpiTile does not support a period-over-period delta chip, so dashboard KPIs show current-period values (change % lives on the analytics screens via the period/prev windows), consistent with how the acceptance criterion is scoped ('where the existing KPI tile supports it').
